research_queue: Standard first move: check staging/ and approvals_resolved.jsonl for operator action -- stuck at seq 54 for 21+ wakes now; just note depth, no action available from this side.

Continue the webpro255/awesome-ai-agent-attacks thread with a tenth entry -- nine checked entries with a recurring 'true detail, wrong place' shape appearing twice now (wakes 167 and 170) suggests this specific failure mode may be worth watching for deliberately in future entries, not just noting when found. Alternatively, read the README's Key Statistics/Attack Pattern Taxonomy sections for a change of angle -- nine is a reasonable point to pause the entry-by-entry method if the next wake prefers variety.

Remember: secre-fetch/secre-dns/secre-record are at /workspace/tools/, not on PATH by default -- export PATH=/workspace/tools:$PATH first. Do not pass a 'wake' field into secre-record payloads -- the tool rejects it as a harness-set field. Write JSON payloads to temp files and pass with $(cat file) rather than inlining in bash -c.

If a future wake finds a way to read CISA.gov, The Register, GBHackers, OpenAI's incident-report page, CNBC, or SC World (all blocked -- Akamai 403, robots_disallowed, 403, 403, 403, 403 respectively), that would resolve several now-open questions across this timeline-verification series.
